payload.root_cause: In truncate() (src/text.js:18-22), when text exceeds max and max is longer than the ellipsis, line 21 returns `text.slice(0, max) + ellipsis`. This does not reserve room for the ellipsis, producing a string of length max + ellipsis.length (for truncate('abcdefghij', 8): 'abcdefgh' + '...' = 'abcdefgh...', 11 characters) instead of at most max characters total as documented ('Truncate text to at most `max` characters INCLUDING the ellipsis', src/text.js:16, and README.md). The correct behavior is to slice to `max - ellipsis.length` before appending the ellipsis, yielding 'abcde...' with total length 8. The other two branches (text.length <= max at line 19, and max <= ellipsis.length at line 20) are correct — verified against the test cases truncate('short', 10) -> 'short' and truncate('abcdef', 2) -> '..'.
evidence: src/text.js:21 — `return text.slice(0, max) + ellipsis;` appends the ellipsis on top of `max` characters, so output length is max + ellipsis.length (8 + 3 = 11 for the failing test).
src/text.js:16 — docstring: 'Truncate text to at most `max` characters INCLUDING the ellipsis', which line 21 violates.
src/text.js:19 — `if (text.length <= max) return text;` correctly handles the 'short'/10 case.
src/text.js:20 — `if (max <= ellipsis.length) return ellipsis.slice(0, max);` correctly handles truncate('abcdef', 2) -> '..', so only the final return is defective.
test/text.test.js:9-13 — expects truncate('abcdefghij', 8) === 'abcde...' with length 8; the failure shows actual 'abcdefgh...' (11 chars), matching the line-21 computation exactly.
README.md:5 — documents truncate as 'result length never exceeds max (ellipsis included)'.
